item.tib: lha mo srid rgyal dpon g.yog gi gzhung gi nyer mkho lag len
item.coloph: lha mo srid pa rgyal mo yi/ gzhung gi nyer mkho lag len 'di/ drang srong shes rab grags pa dang / bstan ye sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dgon gnas nor bu gling chen du/ sgo yi rnal 'byor khro rgyal pas/ yi ger bkod cing spel ba la/ 'gal dang nyams par gyur srid na/ ma sring dbal mo'i tshogs la bshags/ 'di la brten pa'i dpal yon dang / lha mo sgrub pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ g.yung drung bstan pa dar rgyas shog/
